exercises.title: Compare options: Cedar Court
exercises.intro: Put modification, deed in lieu and foreclosure side by side for Cedar Court, with time, loss and guarantor recovery.

buildup.context: C13 what-if: Cedar Court's month-27 refinance falls through, and payments stop at month 28. Balance $5,140,000 at 7.65%. As-is value $5,000,000; sale costs 3% ($150,000); NCF $35,000 a month. Foreclosure takes 270 days with $60,000 legal costs. A deed in lieu takes 180 days with $35,000. Title shows a $40,000 mechanic's lien. The loan is non-recourse with carve-outs (CORE-DOC-02).

Deed in lieu loss if we pay off the $40,000 lien
lines.hint: A deed in lieu leaves the lien on title (CORE-DEF-04): $311,605 + $40,000. Compare with foreclosure.

lines.hint: Non-recourse: guarantors pay only if a carve-out is triggered (CORE-DOC-02).

exercises.title: REO carrying value and charge-off
exercises.intro: Record Cedar Court as REO at fair value less cost to sell, and find the charge-off at title.

calculator.task: Cedar Court goes to REO: loan $5,140,000, fair value $5,000,000, cost to sell 3% = $150,000. What is the charge-off at title? Then try Birchwood: $3,520,000, $3,400,000 and $102,000. Why is the charge-off smaller than the F-CORE-23 loss?

exercises.title: Missed payment to REO sale
exercises.intro: Put the steps from a missed payment to the REO sale in the right order.

steps: Send written notice of default; default interest runs as the note allows (CORE-SVC-03).
Re-rate the loan and put it on the watch list (CORE-SVC-07).
Check the state's SLT row: default interest, foreclosure method and deficiency.
Get a pre-negotiation letter signed by the borrower and every guarantor (CORE-DEF-01).
Compare the options by F-CORE-23 net loss, counting lost interest (CORE-DEF-02).
If a workout loses least, offer a written, time-limited modification or forbearance (CORE-DEF-03).
If there is no workout, search title, UCC and judgments. Take a deed in lieu only if clean; otherwise foreclose with a receiver (CORE-DEF-04, -05).
At title, get a new appraisal and record the REO at fair value less cost to sell (CORE-DEF-06; F-CORE-42).
List with a broker under a written sale plan, re-test value quarterly, and send each offer to the original approver (CORE-DEF-06).
order.why: Notice, rating and the state check come first, as in T1. No workout talk happens before the letter is signed (CORE-DEF-01). Options are compared by loss before one is chosen (CORE-DEF-02). The option with the lowest expected loss is recommended (CORE-DEF-02). A deed in lieu needs clean title, or we foreclose (CORE-DEF-04). REO is recorded at title, then sold under a plan (CORE-DEF-06).
